runsheet.short_description: Opening plenary (main room): introduce the proposed topics from Dotstorming and form the groups, one per room.
During the plenary, bring the mic to on-site participants who speak.

During the plenary, promote the 4 room hosts ([[Unconference Chair]] and [[Unconference Room Host]]s) to co-host in the hub, so they can move between breakout rooms later. Do not open breakout rooms yet.
Once the topics are out, create 4 breakout rooms named after the topics, and note which on-site room hosts each topic. Open the breakout rooms, allowing participants to choose their room.
Screenshare this notice (in More Info) in the hub. Press 'pause' in the Zoom top bar to freeze the screenshare.
Go to your on-site room. Hosts facilitate ~45 min of discussion, balancing on-site and online participation. Mic runners make sure every on-site speaker uses a mic.
Broadcast a 5-minute warning to all breakout rooms; then close the breakout rooms so everyone returns to the main room.
Make a concluding statement to everyone, on-site and online.
